population: Production instances of `trellis rules check` whose destination is not an externalPackage: first-party sources to first-party or unresolved destinations. Standard-library and external packages are not counted. Known gap: a bare JavaScript import the tool leaves unresolved (destination null, such as node:crypto or esbuild) is not an externalPackage, so it stays in the population as unknown references (see #1088).
rule: A run fails when deviatingPairs, deviatingReferences or partialFiles is above this record. It also fails as lost coverage when deviatingPairs or deviatingReferences is below this record while unknownReferences is above it; with deviations not lower, a rise in unknownReferences is a notice. unknownReferences is the sum of referenceCount over the population's instances with status unknown. An update does not lower the deviations while unknownReferences is above the record unless --accept-unknown-rise is given. comparablePairs, conformingPairs and unknownPairs are information only: a pair is one source file's aggregate, so a file split, merge, rename or deletion moves them without changing coverage.
measurement: `python3 tools/rules-ratchet.py --update`: a debug build of this checkout, its own daemon under a private HOME, a fresh index, then rust-analyzer (trusted) and scip-typescript (restricted) imported.
